quote: DCPS intends not to use the reduction in force (RIF) or abolishment procedures in cases commonly known as “Fall Equalization,” “Spring Excessing,” or in any other excess as defined in this Agreement.
notes: Declarative statement of policy/intent rather than strict contractual duty.

quote: In these situations, DCPS intends to use the performance- based excessing and mutual consent provisions of this Agreement.

quote: DCPS shall notify the WTU in writing prior to any Furlough.
This notice shall include the reasons for the Furlough and all timelines.
Prior to the decision to implement a reduction in force and/or abolishment, DCPS shall discuss other possible options with the WTU.
After DCPS has made a decision to effectuate any reduction in force, abolishment, or furlough, DCPS shall consult with the WTU regarding implementation.

When DCPS determines a RIF, Abolishment, or Furlough may be necessary, the LSAT shall explore alternative ways to address the required budget reductions prior to making a recommendation that affects a reduction of personnel.
notes: LSAT typically refers to a local school administration team.

quote: If the Supervisor’s final decision departs from the recommendation of the LSAT, the Supervisor shall prepare a written justification.
A copy of the justification shall be provided to the Chancellor and President of the WTU.

Upon the request of the WTU President, the justification shall require the approval of the Chancellor, or the Chancellor’s designee prior to implementation of the RIF, Abolishment, or Furlough at the school.

quote: After the effective date of a reduction in force or an abolishment, DCPS shall offer multiple hiring opportunities, e.g., job fairs and interviews, for Teachers subject to the RIF or abolishment.
DCPS shall provide the WTU a listing of all current vacancies and post such list on its Web site.
notes: Compound predicate; single obligation clause.

quote: As vacancies arise after the effective date of a reduction in force or abolishment, DCPS will require principals to interview 2 appropriately qualified Teachers who lost their positions as a result of the reduction in force or abolishment before considering any other candidate to fill a vacancy for the remainder of the school year.
All Teachers who are separated by DCPS according to the provisions of this article shall have the right to reapply to DCPS at any time.

quote: If rehired, such Teachers shall be placed on the next salary step for which they would have been eligible at the time of their separation.
notes: Passive construction imposes placement duty on DCPS.

quote: If rehired within one year of separation, such Teachers shall incur no break in service for pension purposes.
notes: Protects pension continuity upon rehire.

quote: The Parties agree that all provisions of this Agreement are subject to the availability of funds.
notes: Mutual condition precedent; no unilateral entitlement or duty.

quote: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as a promise that Congress, the DC Council, or any other organization shall appropriate sufficient funds to meet the obligations set forth in this Agreement.
notes: Non-appropriation clause; prohibits finding of contractual funding guarantee.

quote: DCPS agrees to provide financial certification that DCPS can meet the obligations of this contract before moving toward final approval.
notes: Administrative certification duty.

quote: The parties agree that the failure to provide the funds to meet the obligations of the Agreement pertaining to base salary, benefits (defined as the provisions governing optical, dental and legal benefits), and mutual consent, is a material breach of contract by DCPS.
notes: Stipulative definition of breach for non-payment of base salary and benefits.

quote: The consequences of that breach will be settled by a court or an arbitrator, unless otherwise negotiated by the Parties.
notes: Dispute resolution mechanism for breach.
